issues.problem: The filter icon is the text glyph U+2637 (trigram) in a text span, which renders as an odd grid of dashes in a fallback font. The original has a clean funnel/sliders icon.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the span with a small inline SVG (three horizontal lines of decreasing length) with flexShrink 0.

issues.where: ProjectCard / frames 0, 44 (third card of the Efficient models row)
issues.problem: The original third-row card carries a green completed badge and a completion date, which makes its layout different. The rebuild drops this and shows a uniform card. Also the 2-line descriptions leave a large empty gap before the metadata block, and the first card wraps to an orphan word at the line end.
issues.suggestedFix: Optional: add a small green badge and a date for index 4 with Persian text, and shorten the description of card 0 so it does not leave a single word on the second line.

issues.problem: marginInlineStart -9 puts the amber caret touching or slightly overlapping the last letter at some steps (visible at frames 17 and 21). The original caret has a 2px gap.
issues.suggestedFix: Use marginInlineStart of about -4 so there is a visible gap.

issues.problem: Persian steps come every about 4.2 frames (6 letters over 21 frames) instead of the original 3f per character. The steps are uneven, so the first letter holds for 4 frames. The end beat at frame 31 and the pause to 42 are preserved. This is documented in the header comment.
issues.suggestedFix: Optional: use a constant 3f per letter and a 6-letter query ending at frame 28, or leave as is.

issues.problem: Stale frames from an earlier attempt are left in the out dir (for example fa.f64 shows a hyphenated query that no longer exists, and f24, f41 and f43 are different file sizes). They do not reflect the current code.
issues.suggestedFix: Delete stale TypeAndFilter.fa.f*.png before the final record.

notes: Strong localization. I re-rendered frames 0, 9, 10, 13, 17, 21, 25, 29, 31, 40, 42, 44, 47, 52, 58, 61, 66 and 72 and compared them with the original. The UI is rebuilt live in Persian, so no Chinese or English text is left and nothing is blurred or hidden (the opaque paper layer covers the baked screenshot, and a 2.2x push-in shows crisp Persian text). Typing uses typeOn prefix slicing: consecutive frames show ن, نا, نان, نانو, نانول, نانولب, each correctly shaped and each step adding one letter. The ZWNJ after و has no visible beat, and the caret sits on the left of the text as RTL requires. Mirroring is correct: header and nav on the right, section labels on the right and counts on the left, search icon on the right, filter on the left, card positions mirrored with 1920-x-w, the stagger rank in index order (first card on the right fades first, matching the mirrored reading order), the selected card slides to the right first-row slot, and the click point and camera cx are mirrored. Vertical sink, float, scale, shadow, ripple and zoom are kept physical. Duration constant (73), frame cues (42, 10, 56, 72), easing, fade (5f, 8px) and ripple timings match the original file. Font Vazirmatn (variable weights, loaded via FaRoot) fits the neutral product UI. Persian digits, ZWNJ (عامل‌ها, می‌کند), ی/ک and punctuation are correct. Header comment is truthful. Remaining issues are cosmetic only.
